items.title: John Batiste "Bat" Mosley Interview, 1961-09-23
items.q: He was telling us about a man by the name of Wilson, that, wasn't that Wilson that plays the clarinet?

ctx.x: That's why we thought we'd better be talking to him. I could make a good drum out of him too.
But he won't get in the local, you see. He was in there. He was telling us about a man by the name of Wilson, that, wasn't that Wilson that plays the clarinet?
Yeah, he didn't know his first name.
